[RTCT.6.9] **The fault-fact pool is not a contract field.** Its size is the
program's fault-fact site count ([LERR.9.10]), which the artefact header carries
for every program, under `realtime` or not. `RealtimeContract` carries no field
for it, a `.dsrt` cannot declare it, and it does not join the
`ds.contract.v1` canonical serialization ([RBND.4b]). The pool is allocated
separately from `wm_max`.
